name: DyCheck
description: A monocular dynamic-scene benchmark comprising diverse real-life deformation sequences captured with an iPhone, introduced to evaluate dynamic view synthesis under a realistic monocular capture protocol.
citation: Gao, H., Li, R., Tulsiani, S., Russell, B., & Kanazawa, A. (2022). Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis: A Reality Check. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022). arXiv:2210.13445. https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13445
